Find documents in the vault — full-text + metadata filters with sort/limit/paging

USAGE
    norn find [OPTIONS]

FILTER OPTIONS
        --text <NEEDLE>
        Full-text body substring. Case-insensitive. Empty string is a no-op

        --eq <FIELD:VALUE>
        Frontmatter equality predicate `field:value`. JSON-typed. An unknown `--field value` filters as `--eq field:value` for fields this vault knows

        --not-eq <FIELD:VALUE>
        Frontmatter `field` is NOT equal to `value`

        --in <FIELD:V1,V2,...>
        Frontmatter `field` is one of the comma-separated values (ANY-of)

        --not-in <FIELD:V1,V2,...>
        Frontmatter `field` is NOT one of the comma-separated values

        --starts-with <FIELD:VALUE>
        Frontmatter `field` (or any array element) starts with `VALUE`. Case-sensitive

        --ends-with <FIELD:VALUE>
        Frontmatter `field` (or any array element) ends with `VALUE`. Case-sensitive

        --contains <FIELD:VALUE>
        Frontmatter `field` (or any array element) contains `VALUE`. Case-sensitive

        --has <FIELD>
        Frontmatter `field` is present (non-null)

        --missing <FIELD>
        Frontmatter `field` is absent or null

        --before <FIELD:DATE>
        Frontmatter `field` (a date) is before `DATE`. ISO 8601 expected

        --after <FIELD:DATE>
        Frontmatter `field` (a date) is after `DATE`

        --on <FIELD:DATE>
        Frontmatter `field` (a date) is exactly `DATE`. Accepts `today`

        --path <GLOB>
        Path glob pattern

        --links-to <TARGET>
        Documents whose outgoing links resolve to TARGET (path, stem, or `[[wikilink]]`). Repeatable; multiple targets are AND'd. Resolved-only — TARGET must resolve to an existing document

        --unresolved-links
        Documents with at least one unresolved link
        Possible values: true, false

        --all
        Return every document — escape hatch when no predicate is specified. Without --all and without any predicate, `norn find` prints its help page (a full-vault dump is almost always a mistake; require opt-in)
        Possible values: true, false

SORT AND PAGING
        --sort <FIELD>
        Sort by field (frontmatter key, `path`, or `stem`). Ascending by default

        --desc
        Sort descending (only meaningful with --sort)
        Possible values: true, false

        --limit <N>
        Maximum number of records to return. `find` defaults to 10; `get` returns every named target

        --no-limit
        Return all records; no limit. Competes with `--limit`; the last of the two given wins
        Possible values: true, false

        --starts-at <N>
        Zero-indexed starting offset for paging. Default 0

OUTPUT
        --format <FORMAT>
        Output format. Default auto-detects: TTY → records, piped → paths
        Possible values: paths, records, json, jsonl

        --all-cols
        Emit the full structured dump for each match: whole frontmatter plus every cache-served facet (`.headings`, the three link sets, `.body`). Competes with `--col` over the projection; the last of the two given wins
        Possible values: true, false

        --col <COL1,COL2,...>
        Comma-separated columns to include. Bare names select frontmatter fields (e.g. `status,title`), exactly like `norn get`. Structural facets are dot-prefixed: `.path`, `.stem`, `.frontmatter` (the whole block), `.headings`, `.outgoing_links`, `.unresolved_links`, `.incoming_links`, `.body`, `.document_hash` (the content hash `edit --expected-hash` wants; opt-in only — never in `--all-cols`). Default (no --col): frontmatter only. Ignored with a warning on paths format

        --no-pager
        Skip the pager even when stdout is a TTY
        Possible values: true, false

EXAMPLES
    norn find --eq type:note --limit 5
        # 5 notes; default sort

    norn find --text reorg --format paths
        # full-text search; pipe-friendly paths

    norn find --has aliases --col title,aliases
        # docs that declare aliases

    norn find --in type:note,log --sort modified --desc
        # two types, newest first

    norn find --eq type:task --links-to norn --format paths
        # tasks that link to a doc; pipe-friendly paths

GLOBAL OPTIONS
    -C, --cwd <CWD>         Run as if norn started in this directory (default: $NORN_ROOT, else the current directory)
        --verbose           Include full diagnostic detail in output
        --no-cache-refresh  Skip the implicit cache refresh before reading the graph
        --color <COLOR>     Color output. Honors NO_COLOR / CLICOLOR_FORCE.
        --vault <NAME>      Target the registered vault with this name (see `norn vault register`)

Documentation: https://github.com/dbtlr/norn
